summary: Frontend-only regression retest completed on public URL for marker routing and Legacy redesign stability. Legacy chapter visuals/content remain intact when opened, but marker routing is still flaky across desktop and mobile, including Timeline and neighboring markers.

ui_bugs.issue: Timeline marker is non-deterministic in repeated loops; click frequently leaves state at circuit instead of opening timeline.
Legacy marker intermittently fails to open Legacy (mixed results: circuit/legacy).
Cars marker intermittently misroutes to other chapter/circuit instead of Cars.
Timeline marker keyboard Enter route is unstable (observed transit instead of timeline in probe).

integration_issues.flow: Circuit overview marker navigation and back-loop
integration_issues.issue: In >=5 consecutive Timeline loops, route result is inconsistent on both desktop and mobile.
Coverage label remains progress-aware, but resulting chapter context after marker click can mismatch intended marker due to routing instability.

action_items: Fix marker click determinism so each marker dot always routes to its own chapter (legacy/timeline/cars) from circuit overview.
Fix keyboard parity for timeline marker so both Enter and Space consistently open timeline.
Re-verify with explicit 5/5 pass criteria for Timeline loop on desktop and mobile after fix.
Review interaction timing between navigate(), hash updates, and activeKey/transit thresholds in SpatialExperience for marker-triggered navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Pointer-event split for labels is correct: marker label cards are visible and computed as pointer-events:none, so label interception is not the remaining blocker.
Root instability appears in state selection timing/thresholds: getActiveKey() transit window and scroll-driven active updates can override marker-driven navigate() results.
Legacy redesign content and structure remain intact when legacy is opened (title/statement/stat rail and values rendered as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL and real marker clicks from circuit overview. Observed desktop timeline loop results: ['circuit','circuit','timeline','circuit','timeline']; mobile loop results: ['circuit','circuit','timeline','circuit','timeline']. Legacy marker and Cars marker also showed intermittent misroutes. Label cards remained visible and non-blocking (pointer-events:none). No horizontal overflow and no console errors seen during this run.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: enter circuit overview, click timeline marker repeatedly with Back-to-Circuit loops; expected timeline each time, actual mixed outcomes including staying on circuit. Similar nondeterminism also seen for legacy/cars markers and Enter key on timeline marker. Likely cause: marker-triggered navigation (navigate->__spatialGo->hash update) races with scrollYProgress-driven getActiveKey/transit assignment, causing activeKey/displayKey to settle to non-target states. Mitigation: add deterministic marker navigation lock/settle (or immediate activeKey pin) until target chapter is reached, and reduce/guard transit override during marker-initiated navigation.
